title: TECHO5 v0.9.30
notes:
- **Sounds of your own.** The wake sound, the error and canceled sounds, a finished timer and the mute sounds can each be a recording of your own: put a WAVE file named for the sound in the device's sounds folder over SSH. 16-bit, 48 kHz, up to 10 seconds; delete it to get the stock sound back. See "Sounds of your own" in docs/setup.md for the file names and an ffmpeg line that converts anything else. Thanks, GraemeF. (#75)
- **AirPlay shows the cover.** Songs played from an iPhone or Mac over AirPlay now show their album art on the screen, as Spotify does. (#80)

Verify this release was built by CI from its own tag:

    gh attestation verify echod-arm --repo HuskerMinion/techo5 --source-ref refs/tags/v0.9.30
